columns.name: Completion Bin Sort
columns.expression: VAR r = institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( r ), BLANK (), MIN ( 95, FLOOR ( r, 5 ) ) )

columns.name: Completion Bin
columns.expression: VAR r = institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] VAR lo = institutions[Completion Bin Sort] RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( r ), BLANK (), FORMAT ( lo, "0" ) & IF ( lo = 95, "–100", "–<" & FORMAT ( lo + 5, "0" ) ) )

columns.name: Regression Eligible
columns.expression: IF ( institutions[level] = "4-year" && institutions[bach_cohort] >= 30 && NOT ISBLANK ( institutions[pct_pell] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] ), 1, 0 )

measures.name: Institutions
measures.expression: COUNTROWS ( institutions )
measures.description: Active institutions in the current filter context; one row per UNITID.

measures.name: Completion Institutions
measures.expression: COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( institutions, institutions[level] = "4-year" && NOT ISBLANK ( institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] ) ) )

measures.name: Mean Completion
measures.expression: AVERAGEX ( FILTER ( institutions, institutions[level] = "4-year" && NOT ISBLANK ( institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] ) ), institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] )
measures.description: Unweighted mean of institution rates, stored on a 0–100 scale. Not a student-level graduation rate.

measures.name: Median Completion
measures.expression: MEDIANX ( FILTER ( institutions, institutions[level] = "4-year" && NOT ISBLANK ( institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] ) ), institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] )

measures.name: Completion SD
measures.expression:
VAR t = FILTER ( institutions, institutions[level] = "4-year" && NOT ISBLANK ( institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] ) )
RETURN IF ( COUNTROWS ( t ) > 1, STDEVX.S ( t, institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] ) )

measures.name: Completion Missing
measures.expression: COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( institutions, institutions[level] = "4-year" && ISBLANK ( institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] ) ) )

measures.name: Completion Skewness
measures.expression:
VAR t = FILTER ( institutions, institutions[level] = "4-year" && NOT ISBLANK ( institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] ) )
VAR n = COUNTROWS ( t )
VAR m = AVERAGEX ( t, institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] )
VAR s = IF ( n > 1, STDEVX.S ( t, institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] ) )
RETURN IF ( n > 2 && s > 0, AVERAGEX ( t, POWER ( DIVIDE ( institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] - m, s ), 3 ) ) )
measures.description: Lesson definition: mean cubed standardized deviation using sample SD; differs from Excel adjusted SKEW.

measures.name: Median Net Price
measures.expression: MEDIAN ( institutions[net_price] )
measures.description: 2022–23; median of institution-level average net prices; in-state at public institutions.

measures.name: Regression Institutions
measures.expression: COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( institutions, institutions[level] = "4-year" && institutions[bach_cohort] >= 30 && NOT ISBLANK ( institutions[pct_pell] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] ) ) )

measures.name: Pell Slope
measures.expression:
VAR t = FILTER ( institutions, institutions[level] = "4-year" && institutions[bach_cohort] >= 30 && NOT ISBLANK ( institutions[pct_pell] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] ) )
VAR n = COUNTROWS ( t )
VAR sx = IF ( n > 1, STDEVX.S ( t, institutions[pct_pell] ) )
RETURN IF ( n > 2 && sx > 0, MAXX ( LINESTX ( t, institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr], institutions[pct_pell] ), [Slope1] ) )
measures.description: Unweighted OLS; four-year institutions, bachelor cohort >=30, complete Pell and completion. Refit within current filters.

measures.name: Pell Intercept
measures.expression:
VAR t = FILTER ( institutions, institutions[level] = "4-year" && institutions[bach_cohort] >= 30 && NOT ISBLANK ( institutions[pct_pell] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] ) )
VAR n = COUNTROWS ( t )
VAR sx = IF ( n > 1, STDEVX.S ( t, institutions[pct_pell] ) )
RETURN IF ( n > 2 && sx > 0, MAXX ( LINESTX ( t, institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr], institutions[pct_pell] ), [Intercept] ) )
measures.description: Unweighted OLS; four-year institutions, bachelor cohort >=30, complete Pell and completion. Refit within current filters.

measures.name: Pell R Squared
measures.expression:
VAR t = FILTER ( institutions, institutions[level] = "4-year" && institutions[bach_cohort] >= 30 && NOT ISBLANK ( institutions[pct_pell] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] ) )
VAR n = COUNTROWS ( t )
VAR sx = IF ( n > 1, STDEVX.S ( t, institutions[pct_pell] ) )
RETURN IF ( n > 2 && sx > 0, MAXX ( LINESTX ( t, institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr], institutions[pct_pell] ), [CoefficientOfDetermination] ) )
measures.description: Unweighted OLS; four-year institutions, bachelor cohort >=30, complete Pell and completion. Refit within current filters.

measures.name: Residual SE
measures.expression:
VAR t = FILTER ( institutions, institutions[level] = "4-year" && institutions[bach_cohort] >= 30 && NOT ISBLANK ( institutions[pct_pell] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr] ) )
VAR n = COUNTROWS ( t )
VAR sx = IF ( n > 1, STDEVX.S ( t, institutions[pct_pell] ) )
RETURN IF ( n > 2 && sx > 0, MAXX ( LINESTX ( t, institutions[grad_rate_bach_6yr], institutions[pct_pell] ), [StandardError] ) )
measures.description: Unweighted OLS; four-year institutions, bachelor cohort >=30, complete Pell and completion. Refit within current filters.
